title: User Auth History by Source IP
description: Full auth history for a user and source IP — confirms presence, pivots on outcome

title: Auth Events Across Suspicious IP List
description: All auth events from a list of suspicious IPs — use for IOC-based user pivoting

title: Failed Auth Attempts by User
description: Failed auth attempts for a specific user — use for brute force or credential stuffing investigation

title: Outbound Connections to Remote IP
description: All network events to a specific remote IP — use for C2, exfil, or lateral movement investigation

title: Outbound Connections to IP List
description: Network activity to any of a list of suspicious remote IPs — use for bulk IOC sweeps

title: Suspicious Process Network Connections
description: List outbound network connections made by a specific process to identify C2 beaconing, lateral movement, or data exfiltration

title: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
description: Identify PowerShell processes launched with encoded command flags (-enc/-encodedcommand), deduplicated by command line

title: File First Seen by Hash
description: Identify the earliest observed occurrence of a file by SHA256 hash to establish initial infection point and patient-zero host

title: Endpoint Sweep by File Hash
description: Sweep all endpoints for a specific file by SHA256 hash to determine blast radius and total scope of exposure, deduplicated per host

title: Parent Process Chain by File Hash
description: Trace the actor and causality process chain for a file hash to identify execution origin, dropper, or loader responsible for delivery

title: Executable Executions by File Hash
description: Find all execution instances of a suspicious binary by SHA256 hash, including spawned child processes and all observed execution paths

title: Daily Ingestion Volume Trend
description: Measure daily data ingestion in GB over a time range to surface volume anomalies, growth spikes, or unexpected drops
